backend.description: PUT /api/payroll/entries/{entry_id} with sfs_override updates SFS to custom value and sets sfs_manual_override_entry flag
PUT /api/payroll/entries/{entry_id} with afp_override updates AFP to custom value and sets afp_manual_override_entry flag
PUT /api/payroll/entries/{entry_id} with overtime_override updates overtime amounts and recalculates gross/net
Without overrides, SFS calculates at 3.04% rate (not 3.07%)
SFS, AFP, and overtime overrides can all be applied simultaneously
